notes.title: New Release - Europa Universalis III Divine Wind
notes.notes:
Divine Wind, the latest expansion for Europa Universalis III is now available on Steam!

This 4th expansion of the classic historical strategy game enhances every aspect of the game to create an even deeper and more rewarding experience. Includes 50 all-new achievements!

To celebrate this release, Europa Universalis III: Complete and the Heir to the Throne expansion are 80% off until January 27th!
